// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: contains
// The shape F55 is about: a value that came in from a request, handed straight
// to a LIKE. Prisma does not escape the wildcards, so a query of "%" returns
// every row of the table.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function searchSchools(query: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { name: { contains: query } } });
}
